title: Derived P/E fallback (price/EPS) serves a negative ratio as status:ok for loss-making companies instead of suppressing it
repro: GET /fundamentals for a symbol with negative trailing EPS and no native P/E from the primary provider (e.g. SIFY, EPS -0.13; VERTEX, EPS -0.25). fundamentals.pe_ratio comes back as a negative number (SIFY -103.15, VERTEX -12.2) with field_meta.pe_ratio = {status:'ok', provider:'derived', basis_note:'price / EPS', reason:null}. No suppression/flag is applied despite eps < 0. Same defect class independently reproduced on 2 of 2 loss-making battery names checked (P17 SIFY, S3 VERTEX) -> a missing eps<=0 guard in the derived-ratio computation, not a one-off.
evidence_file: docs/redesign/verification/r15/rc1/battery/collected/P17_SIFY.json (calls.fundamentals.body: pe_ratio=-103.15384615384615, eps=-0.13, field_meta.pe_ratio); docs/redesign/verification/r15/rc1/battery/collected/S3_VERTEX.json (calls.fundamentals.body: pe_ratio=-12.2, eps=-0.25, field_meta.pe_ratio); census comparison docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/diffs/P17_SIFY.json and S3_VERTEX.json record the pe field as correctly suppressed ('loss-making, PE n/a' / 'correctly null, not a number') at census time
suspected_files: sidecar/services (fundamentals derived-ratio computation path -- not opened this drive, re-diff evidence only)

title: /disclosures/shareholding call status flipped bidirectionally (200<->502) between census and rc1 collection for the same BSE-only symbols
repro: Compare calls.shareholding.status in docs/redesign/verification/r15/battery/collected/<slot>.json (census) vs docs/redesign/verification/r15/rc1/battery/collected/<slot>.json (rc1) for BSE-only slots. 15 slots flip 200->502 (P13 P14 P19 P20 P2 P3 P4 P5 P6 P7 P8 P9 S2 S3 S4); 6 flip 502->200 (P15 P17 P18 P1 S1). Concurrent with this rc1 sidecar's own Yahoo circuit-breaker churn (opens_total 26->28, throttles_total up to 287) from its background fundamentals_warm job, consistent with endpoint/rate-limit flakiness rather than a deterministic code regression.

title: P6 ICON and P18 ONC fundamentals returned fully null because this rc1 sidecar's own concurrent cache-warm job had the Yahoo circuit open at collection time
repro: calls.fundamentals.body.polite.yahoo_open == false for P6 ICON and P18 ONC in the rc1 collected data; the call fell through to the openbb-mcp provider and every fundamentals field came back null. sidecar.log shows the background fundamentals_warm job hitting 429s and backing off ~543s concurrently with these two collector calls. Not usable as regression evidence -- would need a clean re-collect with the warm job paused.
